verdict.rationale: Next.js is a React web framework. It does not manage a collection of user items, records or resources that could be acted on in bulk, so this story's axis does not fit the product type. Codemods that transform a codebase during upgrades (next-js-docs-21) are a different capability and are not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
